name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0.1: bay layout now distinguishes kiosk-local aisle state from Weimi state. The layout view was showing only Weimi isEnable/isBroken, so a set_aisle_enabled toggle (which drives the kiosks disabledAisles) appeared to do nothing there. Layout endpoint now returns disabledAisles and the bay grid marks kiosk-closed aisles distinctly (not selling badge, dashed border, dimmed) with titles that label each state as (Weimi) or (kiosk). Weimi isEnable/isBroken remain unwritable by us and are shown as informational. Cumulative over v6.0.
